name: initiate_remote_wipe
description: initiate_remote_wipe: Dispatch a remote wipe command to a compromised device. Links the wipe to an existing security case.

asset_tag.description: The asset tag of the device to wipe (e.g. AST-LPT-284719).

security_case_id.description: The security case ID to link the wipe to (e.g. SEC-048271).
